mapper.sql: id, electricity_category, base_price, peak_price, valley_price, effective_date, implementation_plan, preferential_policy, pricing_method, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT p1.id, p1.electricity_category AS electricityCategory, p1.base_price AS basePrice, p1.peak_price AS peakPrice, p1.valley_price AS valleyPrice, p1.effective_date AS effectiveDate, p1.implementation_plan AS implementationPlan, p1.preferential_policy AS preferentialPolicy, p1.pricing_method AS pricingMethod FROM price_standard p1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT electricity_category, MAX(effective_date) AS maxDate FROM price_standard WHERE deleted = 0 AND effective_date <= #{queryDate} GROUP BY electricity_category ) p2 ON p1.electricity_category = p2.electricity_category AND p1.effective_date = p2.maxDate WHERE p1.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p1.electricity_category

SELECT electricity_category AS electricityCategory, COUNT(*) AS versionCount, ROUND(AVG(base_price), 4) AS avgBasePrice, ROUND(MAX(base_price), 4) AS maxBasePrice, ROUND(MIN(base_price), 4) AS minBasePrice, pricing_method AS pricingMethod FROM price_standard WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY electricity_category, pricing_method ORDER BY electricity_category
mapper.update:
UPDATE price_standard
electricity_category = #{electricityCategory}, base_price = #{basePrice}, peak_price = #{peakPrice}, valley_price = #{valleyPrice}, effective_date = #{effectiveDate}, implementation_plan = #{implementationPlan}, preferential_policy = #{preferentialPolicy}, pricing_method = #{pricingMethod}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
